notes: Phase 4: the Z.ai chat engine is now a fully autonomous agent. New Autonomy control on the Z.ai tab (Off / Ask each / Safe auto / Full auto - Full auto is the default): RUN: commands from the model execute in your project's private Linux workspace and the results flow back into the same conversation until DONE. Live in the chat: a collapsible Commands-run activity log, an approval card when commands wait for you (Ask each / Safe auto), and a final report card (rounds, commands, refusals, stop reason, summary). Safety: hard rails refuse destructive commands without asking (rm -rf outside the workspace, force pushes, history rewrites, remote deletions, system commands, fork bombs, curl|sh, env/token printing) with bypass hardening; token values travel only as environment variables (git uses a process-scoped credential helper - never .git/config or remote URLs); command output is redacted and tail-bounded before returning to chat.z.ai; an untrusted-data rule is taught to the model; budgets cap the loop (40 rounds, 120s per command, total-output cap, no-progress detection). The loop never touches startup and is fully crash-safe.
